build.name: rewrite-audit
build.description: rewrite, audited: SIG_AUDIT_GL=1 and Servo's timing lines (not for performance comparisons)

definition.description: rewrite, audited: SIG_AUDIT_GL=1 and Servo's timing lines (not for performance comparisons)

build.config:
# sig's configuration for benchmark runs of the rewrite, in the format of decision 28
# (version 1: bindings in [keys], not the baseline's [ui.keys]). The same keys do the same
# things as in baseline.config.toml, because the interaction scripts press them. bench/measure
# replaces "{workloads}" with the absolute path of bench/workloads.
version = 1

[keys]
"ctrl-l" = "location.focus"
"ctrl-tab" = "tab.next"
"ctrl-q" = "browser.quit"
"ctrl-t" = "tab.new"
"ctrl-w" = "tab.close"
"ctrl-o" = "page.open {workloads}/article.html"

article.description: Static Servo page: a text-heavy article with four images. Scrolls down, then up.

long.description: Scrolling a long text page (80 sections, ~26 000 words) with the mouse wheel.

css-animation.description: Servo: endless CSS transform, opacity, color and width animations. Pointer moves in the active window.

canvas.description: Servo: a 2D canvas redrawn every animation frame (300 balls). Pointer moves in the active window.

webgl.description: Servo: a WebGL quad rotating in 3D, redrawn every animation frame. Pointer moves in the active window.

many-tabs.description: Eight tabs of the article, one visible: what hidden tabs cost. Switches tab once a second in the active window.

tab-churn.description: Lifecycle: the article, then ten cycles of opening a new tab, loading the article in it and closing it (one every 2 s); measured again 3 s after the last close.

resize-storm.description: The article while the output changes size and scale four times a second (plan §25 resize storm); restored and measured 3 s later.
